result.instructions: Tools for Vision Helpdesk, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which tickets are overdue right now and who owns them?"; "Show ticket 218 with the whole conversation and summarize what the customer wants."; "Find the client with the email jane@example.com and list their open tickets.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Vision Helpdesk data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run vision_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run vision_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run vision_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. vision_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: vision_get_dashboard_counts
tools.title: Get dashboard counts
tools.description: The ticket counts of the staff dashboard (quick view): for example new, open, overdue and assigned tickets. ticket / quick_view.

tools.name: vision_list_tickets
tools.title: List tickets
tools.description: List tickets, with at most ONE filter: a ticket id, a status id, a department id or a folder (inbox, new, overdue, assigned, trash, spam, draft). Without a filter it lists the tickets the API user can see. Status ids come from vision_list_statuses. ticket / get_tickets.

status_id.description: Only tickets with this status id (vision_list_statuses).

department_id.description: Only tickets of this department id.

include_count.description: Also ask for the total count.

offset.description: How many results to skip (default 0), for the next page.

tools.name: vision_search_tickets
tools.title: Search tickets by reference or subject
tools.description: Find tickets by an EXACT ticket reference (the ticket hash such as VHD-218) or an EXACT subject. Give one of them. ticket / get_tickets with a filter on ticket_hash or subject.

ticket_hash.description: The ticket reference, for example VHD-218.

offset.description: How many results to skip (default 0), for the next page.

tools.name: vision_get_ticket
tools.title: Get ticket
tools.description: One ticket with its fields (status, owner, priority, department...) and its posts (the conversation). ticket / ticket_details.

ticket_id.description: Ticket id (the number, not the reference).

tools.name: vision_list_tickets_by_tag
tools.title: List tickets by tag
tools.description: Tickets that carry a tag, by tag id. ticket / tag_search.

tools.name: vision_list_tickets_by_label
tools.title: List tickets by label
tools.description: Tickets that carry a label, by label id. ticket / search_label_tickets.

tools.name: vision_list_statuses
tools.title: List ticket statuses
tools.description: The ticket statuses of a department (ids and names), for filters and status changes. ticket / get_status.

tools.name: vision_list_priorities
tools.title: List ticket priorities
tools.description: The ticket priorities of a department (ids and names). ticket / get_priority.

tools.name: vision_list_ticket_types
tools.title: List ticket types
tools.description: The ticket types of a department (ids and names). ticket / get_ticket_type.

tools.name: vision_list_clients
tools.title: List clients
tools.description: List clients (customers), with at most ONE filter: a client id, a first name (exact), or a parent client id (lists that client's contacts). client / get_clients.

first_name.description: Clients with exactly this first name.

include_count.description: Also ask for the total count.

offset.description: How many results to skip (default 0), for the next page.

limit.description: How many clients to return, 1-200 (default 50). The helpdesk returns the whole list; it is cut here.

tools.name: vision_search_clients
tools.title: Search clients
tools.description: Search clients by name or email text. client / list_clients.

text.description: Part of a client name or email address.

offset.description: How many results to skip (default 0), for the next page.

tools.name: vision_get_client_summary
tools.title: Get client summary
tools.description: A client's summary: notes and ticket counts. client / get_summary.

tools.name: vision_create_ticket
tools.title: Create ticket
tools.description: WRITE: confirm:true required. open a new ticket for a client, given by client id or email. By default no email and no autoresponder is sent; a normal ticket's first post is created on behalf of the client and shown to the client. Internal tickets are staff-only and cannot have client recipients or email enabled. Look up the department, status, priority and type ids first (vision_list_statuses, vision_list_priorities, vision_list_ticket_types). ticket / open_new_ticket.

confirm.description: Required: confirm the exact change and any client-visible or email effects before setting true.

domain_id.description: Domain id the ticket is opened under (1 on a single-domain helpdesk).

from.description: The from address shown on the post, for example support@yourcompany.com.

client_id.description: The client the ticket is for. Give this or client_email (not needed for an internal ticket).

client_email.description: A valid client email address. Give this or client_id.

owner_ids.description: Staff ids that own the ticket.

send_autoresponder.description: Send the autoresponder email to the client (default false).

send_email.description: Send the post by email to the client (default false).

visible_to_client.description: Show the first post to the client (default true).

as_client.description: true (default): the post is the client's own; false: it is a staff reply.

tools.name: vision_reply_to_ticket
tools.title: Reply to ticket
tools.description: WRITE: confirm:true required. add a staff reply to a ticket. Say explicitly whether the client can see it (visible_to_client) and whether it is emailed to the client (send_email, default false). ticket / reply_ticket.

confirm.description: Required: confirm the exact change and any client-visible or email effects before setting true.

from.description: The sender name or address shown on the reply.

visible_to_client.description: true: the client can see the reply; false: staff only.

send_email.description: Email the reply to the client (default false).

tools.name: vision_add_ticket_note
tools.title: Add ticket note
tools.description: WRITE: confirm:true required. add an internal note to a ticket (not shown to the client). ticket / add_note with notetype 0.

confirm.description: Required: confirm the exact change and any client-visible or email effects before setting true.

tools.name: vision_add_client_note
tools.title: Add client note
tools.description: WRITE: confirm:true required. add an internal note to a client record. ticket / add_note with notetype 1.

confirm.description: Required: confirm the exact change and any client-visible or email effects before setting true.

tools.name: vision_update_ticket_property
tools.title: Update ticket status, priority, department or type
tools.description: WRITE: confirm:true required. change one property of a ticket to another id: status, priority, department or type. Look the ids up first (vision_list_statuses and the like). Changing the department can change which statuses and priorities apply. ticket / update_properties.

confirm.description: Required: confirm the exact change and any client-visible or email effects before setting true.

value_id.description: The id of the new status, priority, department or type.

tools.name: vision_assign_ticket_staff
tools.title: Assign or unassign ticket staff
tools.description: WRITE: confirm:true required. add a staff member as an owner of a ticket, or remove one. ticket / update_properties with action staff.

confirm.description: Required: confirm the exact change and any client-visible or email effects before setting true.

tools.name: vision_add_ticket_tag
tools.title: Add tag to ticket
tools.description: WRITE: confirm:true required. add a tag (by title) to a ticket. ticket / add_live_tag.

confirm.description: Required: confirm the exact change and any client-visible or email effects before setting true.
